newsitem.title: USA: PXRE forms managing agency at Lloyd's.
newsitem.headline: PXRE forms managing agency at Lloyd's.

text.p: PXRE Corp said it formed a London-based managing agency to oversee the affairs of its newly-formed underwriting syndicate at Lloyd's, Syndicate 1224.

The new syndicate, formed and capitalized as a subsidiary of PXRE, began underwriting activities on Monday and will participate fully in the January 1997 renewal season, PXRE said. The new syndicate will provide PXRE with access to Lloyd's worldwide license in insurance, reinsurance and surplus lines.
It also is expected to create additional opportunities to grow in other areas that are not currently available to PXRE in the United States, PXRE said.
It will have an initial capacity to underwrite 35 million stg in annual premiums, which may be expanded as market conditions warrant, PXRE said.
The new syndicate will be headed by Peter Butler, who has nearly 30 years experience in non-marine insurance underwriting, both in Lloyd's and the London company market, PXRE said.
PXRE chief executive Gerald Radke said the company decided to form the new managing agency to avoid the potential liability that might have attached to an existing agency.

"In addition, with no names other than PXRE Ltd in the syndicate, the company will be free to implement an underwriting strategy that is compatible with the goals and risk/reward profile that we have established within PXRE," he said.
Longer-term, the new managaging agency will be well- positioned to serve other syndicates and create a fee-based revenue stream for the company.
